# Auphere

> Auphere builds, operates and answers for AI agents in production — AI as a Service
> for companies that need the outcome without building an AI team, and for technology
> and service companies that want to offer AI to their clients without building the
> platform. EU-hosted, EU AI Act Article 50 compliant by design, human escalation
> enabled by default. Operated 24/7 by the team that built it.

## What Auphere is

Auphere operates an AI agent platform with three delivery models: Direct (your agent,
built around your operation and operated by us), Reseller (agencies and MSPs sell
under their own brand at their own price; Auphere runs the platform and the
guarantees), and Embedded (AI inside a SaaS product via API). The home page routes
these as "hire it · resell it · embed it".

Every commercial claim on the site is backed by a claims registry enforced in CI:
capabilities that do not exist yet are always published with a date, never as if live.

## Capabilities in production today

Understanding voice notes and photos (not just text) · per-customer memory across
conversations · 10 vertical skills (health, claims, pre/post-op, escalation…) ·
continuous evals with an automated judge and per-vertical rubrics · browser automation
for software without an API · STAGED→ACTIVE versioning with owner approval and audited
rollback · database-enforced tenant isolation (RLS) with blocking tests · WhatsApp
number-quality hygiene with Meta · owner backchannel over WhatsApp · human escalation
with three triggers and full context.

## Channels

WhatsApp Business API, Instagram DM and TikTok business messaging are live. Real-time
voice is on the technical roadmap with an assigned phase (audio replies to voice notes
land earlier). Integrations: calendars (Google Calendar, Booksy, Treatwell, Fresha…),
CRMs, payments, and anything with a documented API — plus the browser-automation rule
for systems without one.

## Pricing (Direct tier, published)

All pricing in USD, taxes not included. 50% on signing, 50% on kickoff. 10% off billed
annually. Cancel any month after the first three with 30 days notice.

- **Essential** — $850 setup + $120/mo. Up to 1,500 conversations/mo, 1 channel.
- **Pro** — $1,490 setup + $249/mo. Up to 4,000 conversations/mo, up to 3 channels.
- **Business 360** — $2,990 setup + $390/mo. Up to 10,000 conversations/mo, 4h incident-response window.

Enterprise and partner economics are discussed in calls, not published.

## Use cases (verticals with dedicated pages)

- [Barbershops](/en/use-cases/barbershop) — voice receptionist, WhatsApp bookings, reminders, waitlist, review capture.
- [Nail salons](/en/use-cases/nail-salon) — bookings, price quotes, technician matching, 24/7 multilingual.
- [Spas & wellness](/en/use-cases/spa) — after-hours bookings, prep reminders, upsell, gift cards.
- [Medspas](/en/use-cases/medspa) — lead qualifier, consult booking, compliance-aware handoff.
- [Dental clinics](/en/use-cases/dental-clinic) — recall, reminders, insurance pre-check, emergency triage.
- [Physiotherapy](/en/use-cases/physiotherapy) — session reminders, HEP adherence, package management.
- [Veterinary](/en/use-cases/veterinary) — 24/7 emergency triage, vaccination reminders, multi-pet management.
- [Pharmacies](/en/use-cases/pharmacy) — WhatsApp assistant, refills, photo prescriptions, pharmacist escalation.
- [Language schools](/en/use-cases/language-school) — enrollment, trial booking, parent comms in 95+ languages.

## Compliance and data

- The agent identifies itself as AI from the first message on every channel (EU AI Act
  Article 50, applicable since August 2, 2026). Full posture published at /en/trust.
- Human escalation ships enabled by default — which is also what Spain's Ley 10/2025
  requires of customer-service bots from December 28, 2026.
- EU-hosted production runtime by default; vendor exceptions listed in the privacy policy.
- DPA signed before any real client data flows. Client data never trains models sold to others.
- SOC 2 is on the certification roadmap (not started — we say it plainly); security
  questionnaire and documented controls available under NDA.
- HIPAA: not currently in scope.

## Regulation guides

- [EU AI Act Article 50 (EN)](/en/eu-ai-act-article-50) — do chatbots have to disclose they are AI in the EU? Yes: what the article requires, who it binds, white-label liability, extraterritoriality.
- [Art. 50 Reglamento IA (ES)](/es/eu-ai-act-article-50) — la misma guía en español.
- [Ley 10/2025 (ES only)](/es/ley-10-2025-atencion-cliente) — desde el 28-dic-2026 tu bot debe ofrecer un humano: a quién aplica, qué exige, los tres errores típicos y checklist de cumplimiento.

- Active markets: Spain, United Kingdom, Germany, Netherlands, United States, Mexico, Chile, Colombia, Argentina, Venezuela.
